outcome: Admissions to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Two cohorts of singleton term pregnancies with cephalic presentation: 1998-1999 (n = 7437) and 2004-2005 (n = 8505)
finding: Increasing the cesarean section rate from low to moderate did not improve short-term neonatal outcomes in term singleton pregnancies.
mod_finding: Increasing the cesarean section rate from low to moderate did not improve short-term neonatal outcomes in term singleton pregnancies.
